title: Dwelling Limits and Percentage-Based Coverages — Manufactured Home Insurance
content:
On Manufactured Home Insurance the dwelling limit is the anchor figure of the policy: each form writes it only within a set range, and four further coverages are expressed as a percentage of it.

## Dwelling limit range

| Policy form | Smallest dwelling limit written | Largest dwelling limit written without referral to the carrier |
|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | $15000 | $150000 |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | $25000 | $175000 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | $15000 | $150000 |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | $25000 | $200000 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | $30000 | $250000 |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | $40000 | $275000 |

## Coverages set as a percentage of the dwelling limit

| Policy form | Personal property | Other structures (sheds, carports, decks) | Loss of use (additional living expense) | Additional debris removal |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | 40% | 10% | 10% | 5% |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | 40% | 10% | 10% | 5% |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | 50% | 10% | 20% | 5% |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | 50% | 10% | 20% | 5% |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | 50% | 10% | 20% | 5% |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | 60% | 10% | 30% | 5% |

Each of these limits is the stated percentage of the dwelling limit on the same policy; a change to the dwelling limit therefore moves all four with it. Debris removal is an additional limit over and above the dwelling limit.

## Worked example (hypothetical dwelling limit)

A hypothetical dwelling limit of $100,000 gives:

| Coverage | Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Personal property | $50,000 (50%) | $60,000 (60%) |
| Other structures | $10,000 (10%) | $10,000 (10%) |
| Loss of use | $20,000 (20%) | $30,000 (30%) |
| Additional debris removal | $5,000 (5%) | $5,000 (5%) |

## Points of judgement on the range

- A dwelling limit equal to the smallest figure shown, or to the largest figure shown, lies within the form's range.
- A requested limit of $160,000 is above the largest figure written without referral on both Actual Cash Value forms ($150000) but within the range of every other form.
- A requested limit of $20,000 is below the smallest figure of every form except the two Actual Cash Value forms ($15000).
